nodes.long_description:
1.Mix luminol and sodium peroxide 1:5
2.Add the compound to the sprayer canister.
3.Turn off the light and use the sprayer to locate the weapon with bloodstains.
4.Pour the adhesive onto a petri dish in the chamber and heat it to search for fingerprints.
5.Identify the culprit by looking at the fingerprints.

Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and materials, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of science in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
